note: Linux, libx264/libx265 through PyAV, 480 pictures per stream (adversarial: 600); NOT PS5 streams, not the PS5's encoder. Each stream goes through PushStreamDedup and ContentDedup as in the engine. droppedNew: a new game picture the engine would drop (the number that matters). droppedNewIdentical: of those, pictures whose decoded luma is the same as the picture before in every sample (nothing visible lost). falseRepeat: a new picture the classifier called a repeat. missedRepeat: a repeat that is kept (harmless). worstDroppedPixel: the largest luma sample difference of any dropped new picture. Block differences: 16x16 block means against the previous decoded picture, 8-bit code values. Classifier: engine::streamDedupConfig() (StreamCadence.h defaults with exactOnly, since the third review); secondRound: exactOnly=0.
thresholds: fourth review: engine::streamDedupConfig (exactOnly, exactPixel 0.5, suspendAfter 2, resumeAfter 4) and chroma required (not read by the GPU pass: all chroma not measured unless --chroma); thresholds as frozen in ca68b33f
